basis: The independent visual notes explicitly state the 2020 data point values: 13993 for 'Rest of the world' (blue) and 16194 for 'U.S.' (red). Since 16194 > 13993, the U.S. has the larger 2020 value. The task requires opening the regional statistics follow-up record for the region with the larger value. The option 'Open 2020 U.S. international statistics follow-up record' directly matches this requirement.
option_label: Open 2020 U.S. international statistics follow-up record
